{{Quote|The most daring, ruthless pirates of the Gordian Reach&mdash;wherever that is!|Qaraah|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Howling Tempest Gang''' was an infamous criminal gang that was active in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]] owed the Howling Tempest a large debt.

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' will be mistaken for the captain of the Howling Tempest Gang, while Republic players will be mistaken for the leader of the [[Red Hulls]].
